title: Singapore’s Role in Coal-fired and Gas-fired Independent Power Producer Projects in the Region
what_it_is: Singapore’s Role in Coal-fired and Gas-fired Independent Power Producer Projects in the Region

sections.label: Local banks coal financing
sections.summary: In April this year, Singapore's three local banks announced they would cease financing new coal-fired power plants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: For example, in April this year, our three local banks announced their decisions to cease financing of new coal-fired power plants.

sections.label: Singapore sustainable finance measures
sections.summary: The passage lists ABS responsible financing guidelines, SGX comply-or-explain reporting, MAS Green Bond Grant Scheme, over S$6 billion green bonds, and its expansion to Sustainable Bond Grant Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The Association of Banks in Singapore issued the Guidelines on Responsible Financing in 2015 to support responsible lending by banks, particularly in industries with higher ESG risks, including the energy industry.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The Singapore Exchange introduced a “comply-or-explain” regime for sustainable reporting for all listed companies, beginning from the financial year ending on or after 31 December 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: To spur the use of capital market instruments and promote the adoption of standards for green investment products, MAS introduced the Green Bond Grant Scheme in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: To date, over S$6 billion of green bonds have been issued in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The grant scheme has been expanded in February this year to include social and sustainability bonds and renamed the Sustainable Bond Grant Scheme.

sections.label: Government non-interference in investments
sections.summary: The Government does not interfere or influence their individual investment decisions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The Government does not interfere or influence their individual investment decisions.

sections.label: GIC and Temasek coal funding
sections.summary: The passage asks if the Ministry will urge GIC to stop funding coal-power projects, and states GIC and Temasek decide on a commercial basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can I ask whether the Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources will be urging the Government Investment Corporation of Singapore (GIC) to also stop funding coal-power projects?

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have said that, whether it is GIC or Temasek Holdings, they make their decisions on a commercial basis.
